result.topic_en: Draft of §14c on the geometric representation of a function of z by a surface S over the plane B, discussing how the connectivity (Zusammenhang) of S relates to that of a surface T when the function w is everywhere continuous, and the role of branch points.

methods.what: Continuity of w implies that S can be given the same connectivity as T
methods.quote:
Wenn die Function w in T überall stetig ist, so kann {+offenbar+} [-den-] Theilen der Fläche S
derselbe Zusammenhang beigelegt werden, wie den Theilen der Fläche T.

items.quote:

derselbe Zusammenhang beigelegt werden, wie den Theilen der Fläche T.
items.english: If the function w is everywhere continuous in T, then the parts of the surface S can obviously be assigned the same connectivity as the parts of the surface T.

The latter shall be proved immediately.
